answer_1.quote: In this work, we contribute to this pressing area of research while focusing on a specific domain: persuasion in online discussions.
answer_1.outputs: LLM-generated counter-argument comments to CMV posts

answer_2.quote: We extract two types of features for all posts and (human-written and model-generated) comments: a) linguistic, e.g., textual complexity, syntactic structures, use of emotions (301 features), and b) argument quality, e.g., whether the argument is sound or rhetorically impactful (27 features drawn from both argumentation and social science theory on discussion quality).
automatic_metrics: argument quality features (e.g., cogency, justification, impact)
linguistic features (e.g., TTR, emotion intensity, POS variability)
